message.content:
This is a coin purse with an outer surface of textile materials (polyester satin back) and a front covered in sequins and beads. The question is which heading it falls under. Heading 4202 covers wallets and purses, and its subheading 4202.32 applies to articles of a kind normally carried in the pocket or handbag with an outer surface of sheeting of plastics or textile materials. Sequins and beads on a textile base are a classification issue. CBP rulings on beaded and sequined purses generally treat the outer surface as textile material, and the sequin and bead embellishment is considered part of the textile outer surface. Subheading 4202.32 is for plastic sheeting or textile materials, and 4202.32.90 is the "other" provision.

Heading 4202.22 covers handbags, which does not fit here. For 4202.32, the subheadings are 4202.32.10 (sheeting of plastics), 4202.32.20 (of textile materials, cotton), 4202.32.30 (of textile materials, other than cotton... in some editions 4202.32.20 is "of vegetable fibers"), 4202.32.90 (other).

The current structure of 4202.32 is:
- 4202.32.10 – Of sheeting of plastics
- 4202.32.20 – Of textile materials, of cotton
- 4202.32.30 – Of textile materials, of vegetable fibers (except cotton)
- 4202.32.90 – Other (including man-made fiber textile)

Older rulings classify beaded purses of this kind as 4202.32.9000, or 4202.99.9000 if the outer surface is beads (glass) rather than textile. Here, the front is entirely covered with plastic sequins and glass beads, so it could be viewed as plastic sheeting or other material. The mixed outer surface suggests a ruling that classifies it by the predominant surface, which is likely the sequins (plastic), giving 4202.32.1000. Sequins are not sheeting, though. Beaded and sequined bags have been ruled under 4202.99.9000 when the outer surface is neither textile nor plastic sheeting. I'll go with 4202.99.9000, though the heading text is "other" and this subheading is the residual one.

{"hts_code": "4202.99.9000", "reason": "A zippered coin purse whose front outer surface is plastic sequins and glass beads, which is neither plastic sheeting nor a textile material, falls in the residual provision for similar containers under heading 4202."}
